ranges.guidance: Upgrade Apache httpd to 2.4.51 or later immediately (the 2.4.50 fix was incomplete); never run 2.4.49 internet-facing.
ranges.title: Path traversal in mod_alias; remote code execution when mod_cgi is enabled

ranges.guidance: Upgrade Apache httpd to 2.4.51 or later immediately; 2.4.50 is not a safe fix for the 2.4.49 traversal bug.
ranges.title: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773: double-encoded path traversal bypass

ranges.guidance: Upgrade Exim to 4.92 or later immediately; audit any internet-facing host that ran 4.87-4.91 for compromise.
ranges.title: Return of the WIZard: unauthenticated remote code execution in string expansion

ranges.guidance: IIS 6.0 is long end-of-life: migrate the site to a supported IIS/Windows version and disable WebDAV.
ranges.title: Buffer overflow in WebDAV ScStoragePathFromUrl (Windows Server 2003)

ranges.guidance: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.8p1 or later (or a distro build carrying the regreSSHion patch) immediately; restrict SSH network access while unpatched.
ranges.title: regreSSHion: race condition in the sshd signal handler on glibc-based Linux

ranges.guidance: Upgrade to OpenSSH 7.9 or later (or a distro build with the CVE-2018-15473 patch); prefer key-only authentication.
ranges.title: Username enumeration via malformed authentication packet handling (affects versions through 7.7)

ranges.guidance: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later (prefer a supported 3.x release), restart every TLS service, and rotate private keys and certificates.
ranges.title: Heartbleed: TLS heartbeat extension leaks process memory. Detection hint only - CyberRakshak never sends heartbeat probes.

ranges.guidance: Upgrade ProFTPD to a supported release (or a distro build with the CVE-2015-3306 patch) and disable mod_copy if it is not required.
ranges.title: mod_copy allows unauthenticated file copy (SITE CPFR/CPTO), leading to remote code execution

ranges.guidance: Upgrade Samba to a fixed release (4.4.14 / 4.5.10 / 4.6.4 or later) and remove anonymous writable shares.
ranges.title: SambaCry: unauthenticated remote code execution via a writable share

ranges.guidance: Upgrade Samba to a fixed release (4.4.14 / 4.5.10 / 4.6.4 or later) and remove anonymous writable shares.
ranges.title: SambaCry: unauthenticated remote code execution via a writable share

ranges.guidance: Upgrade Samba to a fixed release (4.4.14 / 4.5.10 / 4.6.4 or later) and remove anonymous writable shares.
ranges.title: SambaCry: unauthenticated remote code execution via a writable share

ranges.guidance: Replace vsftpd 2.3.4 immediately with a verified build (2.3.5+ or current 3.0.x); treat any host that ran the trojaned tarball as compromised.
ranges.title: Backdoor shipped in the distributed vsftpd 2.3.4 tarball (smiley-face username trigger)
